title: Unit Event — Cheer With My Heart! — Episode6 The Secret to Shining

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! has received an invitation to the Lumina Grand Prix, an idol TV program organized by Ms. Arisawa. At the orientation, the legendary idol speaks of the idea of a "true idol", which resonates with Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
Sis, wake up!
Everyone's already done eating breakfast!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
Mhm...
Just a little bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
What?! But that show's about to start.
I know we have it set to record, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: Yeah, you said you were really looking forward to watching it! What was it called? Close-up Professional, right?

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <The professional we'll be covering this week is the ever-popular idol, Hiyori!>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <From her private life to everything backstage, we'll be taking a close look at what it's really like to be a brilliant idol!>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I get to see what Hiyori's like when she's not working...!)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <This day begins with a meeting for a show.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, there's Hiyori! Even her day-to-day clothes are cute...!)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: <I see. It would be good to include that song. Anything else you'd like to suggest?>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <It's a big venue, so I want to help everyone in the back feel like they're right near the stage.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I could try going out to the stands more than usual, and throwing some signed balls... I wanna do stuff to make them feel seen.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I didn't know this was how you planned for shows...)

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <Yes! My show's coming up, so I've been requesting night practices lately.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Wait, but she just got out of that meeting!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (When does she take breaks and stuff...?)

rows.Speaker: Instructor
rows.Line: <Alright, let's have you go through your new song from the top.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
(Her moves are so sharp!
She really is an amazing dancer...!)

rows.Speaker: Instructor
rows.Line: <You need to exaggerate each movement more, and express what you're feeling more clearly. No one is going to pay attention if you don't dance with more energy.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: She got scolded? But she was so good...

rows.Speaker: Instructor
rows.Line: <Don't look down! You need to constantly focus on connecting with your audience!>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <This is the day of her new song's release event. During the meet-and-greet portion, she has a chance to shake hands with her fans.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, I've been to one of her meet-and-greets before...!)

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<You're coming to see my show?
Thank you so much! I'm looking forward to seeing you there!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Wow, your ribbon's adorable!
You wanted to match the costume for my new song? That's so sweet...!>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Just seeing it is making me smile too.)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <Following her morning session, Hiyori is able to take a break. However...>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
(Wait, she's practicing again?
But she just finished doing her meet-and-greet...)

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
<You have a pretty tough schedule.
Aren't you tired?>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <No, I actually feel very refreshed after getting a chance to speak to my fans!>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <Lastly, we bring you behind-the-scenes coverage of the day of her show!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, but can we go over the timing for the start of the song again?!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I want this show to become an amazing memory for all of you staff as well, and I'll do my best to make that happen.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <So, I look forward to working with you when we do this for real!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <Thank you! I got to see so many of my fans' smiling faces... I really had a wonderful time!>

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
<Truly, congratulations.
I feel encouraged after seeing how hard you worked for this.>

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
<So, what's your secret?
How are you able to work so hard and keep on going without giving up?>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Well...
It's not really a secret or anything...>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <But I keep telling myself that it's important to have heart.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <My goal is to put smiles on the faces of those who are watching me.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I want them to look forward to giving the next day their very best.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I think that's why I'm able to maintain my optimism like this.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (She really wants everyone watching her to smile and be happy...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
I still have so much to learn...
I mean, during those auditions, I was only thinking about myself.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I'll never be able to make anyone happy if I don't—

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
You just kept on practicing, right?
You never stopped working on your singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
After seeing that...
I thought I should be doing the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I guess that means I was able to take a small step forward...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Towards my dream of becoming a dazzling idol.
